# Stat 141: Readings for {{< meta date >}}

Before coming to lecture today, practice using `R` documentation to familiarize yourself with new functions: 

- In the console of a RStudio window, run `library(dplyr)` followed by these R help commands. Skim the
documentation that shows up in the "Help" pane (usually the bottom right of
RStudio). Pay the most attention to the "Description", "Usage", "Arguments", 
"Value", and "Examples" sections. Usually, the most common or important uses and arguments
are mentioned first. Run a few of the provided examples in your
own console for each command.

-   `?arrange`
-   `?group_by`
-   `?summarize`
-   `?filter`
-   `?mutate`
